title: Reverse-Seared Smoked Bison Burgers (225°F)
ingredients: 1 tbsp cold grated butter or olive oil (keeps lean bison juicy during smoking)
1.5 tsp coarse kosher salt, 1 tsp coarsely cracked black pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika
4 slices aged white cheddar or Swiss cheese
4 toasted brioche buns, caramelized onions, lettuce, tomato, and smoky burger sauce
instructions: Preheat smoker to 225°F (107°C) with hickory or oak wood.
Gently mix ground bison with Worcestershire sauce, grated cold butter, garlic powder, salt, and pepper without overworking the meat; form into 4 thick patties with a thumb dimple in the center.
Smoke the bison patties at 225°F for 35–45 minutes until internal temperature reaches 130°F.
Transfer to a screaming-hot cast-iron skillet or direct grill grates for 60 seconds per side to crust, top with cheddar to melt (140–145°F final medium temp), and serve on toasted buns.
sourceTitle: Hey Grill Hey · 225°F Smoked Bison Burgers
